items.title: Curtis Mitchell Interview, 1996-04-02
items.q: And you were on Big Chief with Professor Longhead. Yeah, I was playing on the piano.

ctx.x: I used to do all his copying, you know, like all, but as far as any recording I only did one, that was one called I Surrender. I got it in my band now, you know. I Surrender. The rest of them Wardell Cazell did. He did the Raymond on Kiss DeMar Goodbye and all the rest of his song.
And you were on Big Chief with Professor Longhead. Yeah, I was playing on the piano.
I always have a question about that song.
